summary: The first four frames are a near-static side-on stand, then she abruptly starts turning and swinging her arm at 55.70 with no anticipation, so there is one noticeable snap.

faults.what: Between 55.66 and 55.70 her torso and arm change suddenly. After four near-frozen frames the shirt silhouette changes, the arm swings back and the hand moves to a new place. The torso then keeps turning toward camera through 55.80, with the shirt shading going greyer. It reads as the pose starting abruptly (a snap) with no wind-up, not as a motion that eases in.
faults.fix: Add 2-3 frames of anticipation (a hip and shoulder wind-up) before 55.70, or start the clip already mid-move so the cut lands on motion, not a held stand.
